disclaimer: Research only — out-of-sample historical performance does not guarantee future results. This report does not affect live or paper-trading strategy selection.

executive_summary.explanation: The experiment produced 37 out-of-sample trades across 7 test window(s). Key findings: negative net expectancy of Rs -8.85 per trade after costs; profit factor of 0.52 (below 1); the result did not meet the minimum evidence requirement. Final research verdict: INSUFFICIENT DATA. No live or paper-trading behavior is affected by this report.

performance_analysis.gross_return_note: Gross figures are before configured transaction costs.

benchmarks.note: Window returns summed across test windows (each window restarts at the configured capital); the full model line is the compounded overall return.

risk_analysis.risk_of_ruin_note: Rough Gaussian estimate over 25 sequential trades — an approximation, not a measured probability.
warnings: Top five trades generated 77% of total profit — results depend on a small number of trades.

notes: All trades are long-only (no short side in this system).
Groups labelled VERY LOW / LOW have too few trades to be reliable, regardless of profitability.

warnings: Calibration metrics are based on only 37 samples (LIMITED) — treat with caution.
Higher confidence did NOT correspond with better outcomes in this experiment.
Some confidence bands show negative expectancy — confidence should not be read as trade quality here.

false_positive_analysis.definition: BUY/STRONG BUY entries that lost money after costs, hit the stop, or never achieved at least +1% favourable excursion.
false_positive_analysis.language_note: Associations only — no causal claims. Example: false-positive trades were more frequently associated with the subgroups showing the largest positive differences above, given sufficient samples.

from_phase42_analysis.outcome_model: same stop/target-aware 10-day approximation as the threshold sweeps

missed_opportunity_analysis.note: Diagnostic only — this does not weaken or modify any safety gate. Forward returns were computed inside each experiment window during simulation; no new lookahead is introduced.

from_phase42_analysis.ic_note: Spearman rank correlation between each feature at decision time and the 10-day forward return across ALL buy-signal candidates (entered or not). |IC| > 0.05 is meaningful at this sample size; sign shows direction.

feature_analysis.note: SUPPORTED requires 50+ samples and multi-window consistency. A single profitable bucket does not make a feature important.

highlights.message: Confidence sweep is relatively flat — results not highly sensitive to this parameter.

parameter_sensitivity.note: Sweeps use the stop/target-aware approximation documented in the Phase 4.2 analysis. No single 'best' value is recommended from maximum return alone — prefer stable parameter ranges. Values with VERY LOW / LOW evidence should not drive decisions.

regime_analysis.disclaimer: Analysis-only regime recommendation — not used by live strategy selection.

holding_period_analysis.alternative_exit_note: Controlled alternative-exit analysis using forward returns stored during simulation (gross of costs, close-to-close). Approximation only — actual stop/target behaviour is not replayed.

drawdown_analysis.largest_drawdown_explanation: The largest drawdown was 9.6223% deep, starting 2024-08-01, occurring mainly during the Neutral-Bullish regime, with the largest losses from Trend Rider trades.
